criteria.description: Existing Harness architecture, specialist ownership, pilot boundaries, API contract and data model are explicit and preserve the smallest sufficient architecture.
criteria.limitations: The pilot is disposable and does not establish a production deployment architecture.

criteria.description: Failure taxonomy, reliability/performance bounds, observability and separate security-handoff triggers are specified before implementation.
criteria.limitations: No external dependency, production identity system or production SLO is in scope.

criteria.description: Migration apply/checksum/rollback limits, transaction/idempotency/concurrency behavior and risk-shaped test architecture are specified.
criteria.limitations: Rollback evidence is for a disposable SQLite migration transaction; no production down-migration is claimed.

authority.decision: The specified changes are additive, local and disposable; no external or irreversible action is authorized.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate if the pilot leaves the disposable workspace or introduces production/destructive/security-sensitive scope.

next_action: Write and run the mandatory RED tests, then close the implementation-ready gate before any BUILD/IMPLEMENT/RUN/TEST activity.
revalidation_triggers: Changing API, data, migration, security or architecture contracts
Adding an external dependency, production data, credentials or irreversible migration
